value.info_text:
With some advanced preparation, you learn to create and equip one of a number of useful tools (at level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5):

Hidden Blades:

Melee criticals trigger an extra unarmed attack, inflicting 140%, 157%, 170%, 181%, 191% damage. 4 turn cooldown.

Smokescreen:

Throw a smokebomb creating a radius 2 cloud of smoke, lasting 4, 4, 5, 6, 6 turns, that blocks sight and reduces enemies' vision by 1, 3, 4, 6, 7. 15 turn cooldown.

Rogue's Brew:

Prepare a potion that restores 237, 302, 357, 407, 453 life, 59, 75, 89, 101, 113 stamina, and cures 1, 2, 2, 3, 3 negative physical effects. 20 turn cooldown.

Grappling Hook:

Throw a grappling hook up to range 4, 5, 6, 7, 7 that drags you towards the target or the target towards you. 8 turn cooldown.

Dart Launcher:

Fire a poisoned dart dealing 72, 90, 103, 113, 123 physical damage that puts the target to sleep for 4 turns. 10 turn cooldown.

Preparing a tool sets its talent level and puts it on cooldown.

value.info_text:
You become a master of your craft, allowing you to focus on a single tool (currently none) to greatly improve its capabilities:

Hidden Blades (Assassinate)

You prime your Hidden Blades to cause bleeding and facilitate the Assassinate ability, which allows you to strike twice for 241%, 266%, 285%, 302%, 316% unarmed damage, hitting automatically while ignoring armor and resistance.

Smokescreen (Smokescreen Mastery)

Your Smokescreen is infused with chokedust. Enemies in the smoke take 87, 105, 118, 128, 138 nature damage and may be silenced.

Rogue's Brew (Rogue's Brew Mastery)

Your Rogue's Brew fortifies you for 8 turns, preventing you from dying until you reach -156, -347, -494, -617, -726 life.

Grappling Hook (Grappling Hook Mastery)

Your grappling hook deals 100% unarmed damage when it hits, plus a further 104, 127, 144, 158, 170 physical and 104, 127, 144, 158, 170 nature damage over 4 turns.

Dart Launcher (Dart Launcher Mastery)

Your darts ignore poison and sleep immunity and waking targets are slowed by 20%, 29%, 34%, 37%, 40% for 4 turns.

The effects depend on this talent's level.

Mastering a new tool places it (and its special effects, as appropriate) on cooldown.

Focus your will into a powerful thrust of your telekinetically-wielded weapon to impale your target and then viciously rip it free.

This deals 206%, 229%, 247%, 262%, 275% weapon damage and then causes the victim to bleed for 234, 317, 382, 437, 485 Physical damage over four turns.

At level 3 the thrust is so powerful that it has 29%, 58%, 71%, 79%, 84% chance to shatter a random temporary magical or psionic damage absorbing shield if one exists.

The bleeding damage increases with your Mindpower.

value.info_text:
Your mastery of necromancy becomes so total that an aura of undeath radiates around you in radius 4, 5, 6, 8, 9.

Any undead minion standing inside of it is protected, increasing all their resistances by 9%, 12%, 15%, 18%, 20%.

In addition when you create new minions they inherit 19%, 27%, 32%, 36%, 40% of your spellpower (applied to any powers), spell crit chance (applied to any crit chances), saves, resists, and highest damage increase (applied to all elements).

value.info_text:
You control dead matter around you, lying in the ground, decaying.

When you enter combat and every 29, 19, 15, 13, 12 turns thereafter a ghoul of level 45, 48, 50, 52, 53 automatically raises to fight for you.

At level 3 you can forcefully activate this spell to summon up to 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ghasts around you.

At level 5 every 4 summoned ghouls or ghasts a ghoulking is summoned for free.

Ghouls, ghasts and ghoulkings last for 5, 7, 8, 10, 11 turns.

Ghoul minions come in larger numbers than skeleton minions but are generally more frail and disposable.

value2.info_text:
You infuse blighted energies into all of your summons, granting them Bone Shield (level 3) and a bonus to Spellpower equal to your Magic.

Your Wilder Summons and Necrotic Minions will gain special corrupted talents (level 3), other summons will gain 10% Blight damage conversion and Virulent Disease (level 3).

Wilder Summons:

  • War Hound: Gnaw
  • Jelly: Curse of Defencelessness
  • Minotaur: Ruin
  • Golem: Acid Blood
  • Ritch: Life Tap
  • Hydra: Blood Spray
  • Rimebark: Poison Storm
  • Fire Drake: Flame of Urh’Rok
  • Turtle: Elemental Discord
  • Spider: Blood Grasp

Necrotic Minions:

  • Skeleton Mages: Bone Spear
  • Skeleton Archers: Bone Spike
  • Skeleton Warriors: Ruin
  • Bone Giants: Bone Spike and Ruin
  • Ghouls: Virulent Disease
  • Dread: Slumber
